newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Fifth Third raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Fifth Third raised to buy.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said it upgraded Fifth Third Bancorp to buy from hold.

-- "Our analysis of recently reported fourth quarter results reinforces our belief that the company is likely on the verge of a more proactive stand regarding balance sheet and capital maangement," Salomon analyst Michael Plodwick said in a report.
-- The analyst raised his 1997 earnings estimate to $3.85 from $3.75 and 1998 to $4.50 from $4.35.
-- He set at 12-month price target of $75 to $77 on the stock, which was up 2-3/4 to 67-1/2.
